title: Dreamy Softness
summary: A world of heightened sensuality, lyricism, and tactility that bridges painting and poetry.

sections.heading: Exhibition Overview
sections.body: At my solo exhibition "Dreamy Softness" (Meko od snova), held in July 2023 at the KvArt BW exhibition space in collaboration with Gallery Štab, I invited the audience into a world of heightened sensuality, lyricism, and tactility that bridges painting and poetry.

sections.heading: Concept & Artistic Expression
sections.body: The exhibition explored realms of emotional intimacy, delicate atmospheric layers, and internal psychological landscapes. Through a careful interplay of textures, organic nuances, and poetic resonance, the works function as visual fragments of dreams - evoking a space where fragility meets profound emotional depth. This series serves as an intimate meditation on tenderness, softness, and the poetic currents that quietly shape human perception.
